            end

                -- no new lines, so we just tack on to end of current line

                if len_text > 0 then

                end

                for i, piece in ipairs(split_lines) do
                    local len_text = #piece
                    if len_text > 0 then
                        -- don't add empty pieces, just make sure we add the lines (even if empty)

        virt_text_pos = 'overlay',
